players.product: DDR5 RCD / MRDIMM register & power chipsets, SOCAMM2, memory-interface silicon IP

quarterly_data.signal: Strategic agreement with ChipAgents: Rambus is adopting ChipAgents' agentic AI chip-design platform companywide, across its chip and silicon IP design and verification workflows; the two will collaborate to combine Rambus silicon IP with ChipAgents' platform to speed customers' chip design and IP integration; and Rambus has become a strategic investor in ChipAgents (amount and stake not stated). CEO Luc Seraphin: 'By adopting the ChipAgents platform, we see opportunities to accelerate the pace of chip and IP development, enhance engineering productivity, and strengthen our long-term position in AI and data-center infrastructure.'
